name: How long does it take to clean up sewage in a crawl space?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to clean up sewage in a crawl space?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of sewage cleanup in a crawl space varies depending on the extent of the contamination, the size of the crawl space, and the amount of structural damage. A small, contained leak might be resolved in 1-3 days, while extensive contamination or structural repairs could take a week or longer. This includes time for sewage extraction, disinfection, drying, and any necessary material replacement. A professional assessment can provide a more accurate timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cleanup time varies from 1-3 days for small issues to over a week for extensive contamination, depending on the damage.
